teacher_info.teaching_style:
All classes are customized to student needs. However, the basic structure is as follows:

For writing classes, we will spend the time editing a writing sample you provide (prompts and questions can be given). We will review grammar, spelling, cohesion, vocabulary and structure.

For pronunciation, we cover four key concepts needed for a natural accent in American English: placement, pitch, breath, and weak consonants. We take a pronunciation test to find the specific areas of strength and focus before moving to sentence-level structures (intonation, linking, stress, reductions). Our long-term goal: to listen to native speakers, identify what techniques they use, and copy them ourselves.

Organizing will help you develop your plan of action, what to say, how to respond, and what materials you will need. The second focus of delivery covers simply the best way to effectively leave a positive impression on an audience or interviewer and to develop people skills and confidence. pro_course_detail.title: German conversation and language acquisition for adults and younger learners
pro_course_detail.description: Friendly and empathetic learning designed around student needs and learning type: auditory, visual, kinesthetic or digital (a combination of all three types of learning styles). We will focus on speaking and self expression but also on comprehension, both verbal and written.

pro_course_detail.title: German conversation, adapting to German culture, everyday living for parents, professionals and students
pro_course_detail.description: At level B we are conversing with more fluidity, we are refining our language skills and constantly expanding our vocabulary. We can begin to have discussions on a variety of topics, express our views and thoughts and begin exploring an expanded scope of the use of tenses. We can use dedicated materials such as books we read together, movies or series we watch and discuss. Optional written material to support comprehension and expression. If we haven't worked together yet, we will begin by determining the student's needs and their learning style. I offer friendly and empathetic language tutoring.

pro_course_detail.title: German conversation, language refinement, cultural-linguistic exploration
pro_course_detail.description: Level C language classes might be focussed on a specific topic or project either for work or school. Where at Level B we have read light fiction, at Level C we may be reading textbooks, non-fiction or philosophical works or classics. That said, classes will be adapted entirely to the student's goals and aims and not only how they learn best, but will be geared towards their interests. Language acquisition might be necessary for a variety of reasons, but that doesn't mean it can't be fun and entertaining. All levels begin with the student and teacher getting to know each other, discussing what the student's language aims are and what their goals are in general. At Level C we will continue enhancing expression and language flexibility.

course_info.trial_description:
In this 30-minute lesson, I'll evaluate your level of spoken English while performing a complete needs analysis. This will allow me to let you know what expectations I believe are realistic and how your objectives can be reached and in how much time. 

I will also make my self-study material available to you, so you can further whichever subjects we discussed at home and in between our lessons. This includes shared notes and flash cards for practice. 

-> If preparing for exams, be sure to take note of which exams you've already taken and which results you've obtained so far. 

-> In any case, make sure to prepare what you would like to discuss in the lesson. Ideally we should keep to English. We can, however, discuss objectives in Italian or Portuguese, if you feel more comfortable. In our following lessons, though, English will always be the main language of the lesson and other languages will be avoided.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
By setting your targets and preparing a plan for growth, we can start working on the practical aspects of English. 

In these lessons, we will discuss any topics that arise and deepen your knowledge of pronunciation, expression, grammar, vocabulary, listening and appropriacy. We will focus on topics of your interest or need and work towards English becoming a skill to improve your life experience while travelling, studying and building international relationships.

I will take constant notes as to create personalized revision materials for you, so you can study and prepare for your next lessons. 

If working on school or university materials (and not for Certification Exams - such as IELTS and Cambridge), always share specific materials you'd like to revise beforehand via any linked online folders we will have discussed in previous lessons or in our first Trial Lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Certification Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
After evaluating your level and setting realistic targets for your certification targets, we start on your path towards exam day. 

In these lessons, we will discuss any topics that arise and deepen your knowledge of pronunciation, expression, grammar, vocabulary, listening and appropriacy. We will focus on topics that are usually used in the exam you will be taking, as well as familiarizing yourself with exam structure, timing and logic.

I will take constant notes as to create personalized revision materials for you, so you can study and prepare for your next lessons. 

We will share specific materials you have to revise via linked online folders we will have discussed in previous lessons or in our first Trial Lesson.

I've prepared hundreds of students for multiple exams and, with full preparation courses based on each of their targets, have achieved consistent success.

pro_course_detail.title: Semi-Structured Conversation Class

pro_course_detail.description:
This is a structured course about intonation, the rising and falling of the voice. Intonation helps with pronunciation, emotions, and communication. This course will break down the basics into easy, self-paced units. Each unit has one basic skill to master, each unit builds up upon the past units into a comprehensive intonation skill set. There are extra units about special circumstances where the intonation will change. 

The course will study articles, quotes, poetry, and video clips for a vocabulary-rich experience. 

This course includes:
Power points, videos, articles, gifs, pictures, and homework.
AR stickers and green screen technology.

Some of the skills explored are:
1.	Rise and fall
2.	Pacing
3.	Emotions
4.	Word Stress
5.	Connective Speech

teacher_info.intro:
Hi, I'm Alli- your guide to learning English! Born in the USA, I've ventured far and wide, from the peaks of Japan to the cafes of Italy. After a decade of teaching and climbing mountains across the globe, I’ve found my way back to sunny Florida to enjoy the sweeter things in life — playing sports, cuddling with my cats, and whipping up homemade ice cream. 

I believe in learning that energizes and inspires. Join me for a blend of vibrant lessons and personal stories that make mastering English feel as delightful as your morning cup of coffee.

teacher_info.about_teacher: From earning my degree in Education, specifically endorsed in teaching English as a second language, to teaching globally: I've been a live-in ESL teacher in Italy, an elementary school teacher in Bali, and have led English cooking classes in China. I also managed a kindergarten class in Japan and taught online across various platforms. My journey blends education with cultural immersion!
teacher_info.teaching_style: I like to have a very friendly style in my classroom. Always ask questions, never feel embarrassed to speak. I have a variety of lesson sources, usually a structured lesson plan or something more creative involving a game or asking opinions on an article. My lessons are always student driven and I am happy to adapt my lesson to specific needs.

teacher_info.about_teacher: When I studied abroad in South Korea, I helped numerous Korean students practice for English presentations and corrected their grammar in essays. I also did language exchange and met with fellow language learners to help them with English while they helped me with Korean. I am a patient listener and love to make each person I'm helping feel comfortable expressing themselves even if they make mistakes. I am also honest and explain in detail multiple ways they can get their thoughts across. I am excited to have a similar experience with Italki students.
teacher_info.teaching_style: As an Italki tutor, I want to bring out the best in my students and help them express their thoughts clearly in English. My expectation is that every student will have a different cultural background than my own and this leaves room for us to learn more about each other. My teaching style is interactive and playful. I will challenge my students to think on the spot and use new vocabulary.  I do not teach children under the age of 10 years old.
